question: How do you think New Zealand Should Respond to AI as a Society?
intro: Our research team has identified policy responses to AI that we believe will help build a positive future for all Kiwis. Please choose your three favourite policies from the list.

options.title: Fund an Office for AI
options.description: The office will study the risks and opportunities AI poses, so that it can make independent recommendations to the government. The office will also build national expertise in AI, and allow us to collaborate internationally on AI risks.

options.title: Require AI Companies to Provide Reliable AI Detectors
options.description: Make AI companies provide Kiwis with a free tool that lets us check if content was generated with their AI. The European Union has a similar law.

options.title: Harden Our Infrastructure against Catastrophic AI Misuse
options.description: Through the direction of the Office for AI, increase funding for biosecurity (to protect us from AI bioweapons) and cyber defense (to protect us from AI hacking).

options.title: Jobseeker 2.0
options.description: Expand jobseeker to have targeted retraining packages for people in sectors of the economy disrupted by AI automation

options.title: Tax AI Usage to Slow Job Losses and Maintain Government Revenue
options.description: Shift taxation away from human labour, and towards AI service consumption. Do this by adding a tax on workplace AI bills.

options.title: Invest in Publicly Owned AI Infrastructure
options.description: New Zealand should invest in publicly owned AI hardware. This preserves control and privacy and ensures AI is built and deployed in line with our values.

options.title: Retain Human Control Over All Critical Societal Functions
options.description: Pass a 'human in the loop' law ensuring humans will always stay in control of all areas that are critical to the functioning of society, even if AI becomes superhuman.

options.title: Protect our Children From AI Companies
options.description: Similar to the proposed social media ban, all AI chatbots, agents, and companions should be banned for children under 16.

options.title: Allow Companies to Build AI Hardware here in Exchange for Access and Infrastructure Upgrades
options.description: We get priority access to the AI they run on the hardware, and the hardware itself. They must also pay for local infrastructure upgrades to avoid disrupting residents.
